findings.message: End-of-life date 2027-04-16 exceeds the 3-month maximum for upstream-sourced applications without an accepted support plan. The app part sources from https://github.com/canonical/demo-rock. Per §2, end-of-life must be at most today + 3 months (frozen date 2026-10-16, cap 2027-01-16). Request: shorten EOL to 2027-01-16 or earlier, or provide an accepted support plan in CODEOWNERS.

summary: Patch-version update from v1.2.0 to v1.2.1 with no package, service, script, path or permission changes. End-of-life extended 6 months to 2027-04-16, exceeding the 3-month cap for upstream-sourced applications without support plan approval.
